name: Major Histocompatibility Complex Class I Deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for MHC Class I Deficiency

criteria.description: Markedly reduced or absent expression of MHC class I molecules on peripheral blood lymphocytes
Significant reduction in circulating CD8+ T-cell counts
Identification of pathogenic mutations in genes involved in antigen processing (e.g., TAP1, TAP2, TAPBP)
Normal expression of MHC class II molecules

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: low MHC class I expression, CD8+ T-cell deficiency, and genetic confirmation of causative mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other immunodeficiencies affecting T-cell subsets.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Markedly reduced MHC class I expression on lymphocytes

common.symptomName: Chronic nasal congestion and otitis media

occasional.symptomName: Cutaneous viral infections (e.g., warts, molluscum contagiosum)

laboratory: Flow cytometry showing absent or markedly reduced MHC class I expression on lymphocytes
Reduced CD8+ T-cell counts with normal CD4+ T-cell counts
Normal immunoglobulin levels in most cases
imaging: Chest radiographs showing recurrent or chronic pulmonary infections
Sinus CT scans demonstrating chronic sinusitis
genetic: Pathogenic mutations in TAP1, TAP2, or TAPBP genes confirmed by molecular genetic testing
other: Normal MHC class II expression on antigen-presenting cells
Negative HIV testing to exclude secondary CD8 lymphopenia

distinguishingFeatures: Deficiency of MHC class II expression
Profound deficiency of both T and B lymphocytes
Absent or very low T-cell function

redFlags: Recurrent severe bacterial respiratory infections in infancy
Marked CD8+ T-cell lymphopenia with normal CD4+ counts
Failure to thrive despite standard treatments
references: Al-Herz W, et al. Primary immunodeficiency diseases: an update on the classification from the International Union of Immunological Societies Expert Committee for Primary Immunodeficiency. Front Immunol. 2014.
de la Salle H, et al. MHC class I deficiency: a rare primary immunodeficiency. J Clin Immunol. 2016.
